the west front's openings: a round window in the gable, a traceried rose over three lancets in the centre, a lancet each side lower down and two small lancets at the north end's foot; the render carries three rows of the draft's square sash
the gabled stone porch at the centre of the west front with its pointed, traceried doorway, about 7 m wide and to about 10 m at its apex; nothing in the render but the draft's door
the tower's angle buttresses, stepped with gabled offsets at each stage and rising into corner pinnacles beside the gablets; the render's tower is a plain prism

the spire's band of gabled lucarnes at about 58-60 m and its finial; the render's spire is a plain cone with a post at its tip
